Visual design completed. Here's a summary of the design decisions:

## Visual Design Summary

| Slide | Strategy | Layout | Key Visual Element |
|-------|----------|--------|-------------------|
| 1 | Full-Bleed Image | cover | Isolated researcher silhouette |
| 2 | Single Number | fact | ¥1,400億 in red |
| 3 | Full-Bleed Image | cover | Toyama landscape (anecdote) |
| 4 | Mermaid Diagram | two-cols | 4-node contrast diagram (red vs green) |
| 5 | Styled Cards + v-clicks | default | 3 research areas as cards |
| 6 | Single Number | fact | 20+ vulnerabilities |
| 7 | Mermaid Diagram | center | 5-node hub-and-spoke |
| 8 | Statement | statement | "孤独な天才の時代は終わった" |
| 9 | Full-Bleed + QR | cover | Discord QR code |

## Quality Results

- **Bullet points**: 0 slides use plain bullets
- **Mermaid constraints**: Max 5 nodes used, all labels under 20 chars
- **Image placeholders**: 7 added (anecdotes, logos, QR code)
- **Color consistency**: All slides use the defined palette semantically
- **3-Second Test**: All 9 slides pass

The design follows the Jobs-BCG mindset: every slide has a single clear message, visuals replace text wherever possible, and the audience can grasp each point within 3 seconds.
